summary: Iter633 Paket36 — Public API v1 (keys, scopes, rate limits, idempotency, bookings CRUD, cancel, docs, key update/usage) + Opera Cloud connector + /book-all chain filters + PlatformAdminPanel Public API Keys card & Docs + Connector Catalog 'Bağlan → PMS Connect Hub'. critical_code_review_comments: public_api_v1.py _throttle counter increments before capacity check — even 429 responses count against the bucket; acceptable but note that a burst client stays throttled full minute (documented via Retry-After).
public_api_v1._BUCKETS is process-local (in-memory dict); does not survive workers/restarts and is not shared across replicas. For prod scale-out, move to Redis.

PublicApiKeysCard scope chip data-testid uses `pa-key-scope-{scope.replace(':','-')}` (e.g. pa-key-scope-read-availability) — task spec said `pa-key-scope-*` toggles which matches the pattern but not colon form; keep hyphen form documented.
Connector-catalog uses `key` field for connector id (not `id`) — consistent internally, but partners scripting against the JSON may expect `id`.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_read_key, TEST_write_key, TEST_rl_key, TEST_ui_key public API keys under property aldgate-flats; one booking (source=public_api) created then cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Public API v1 endpoints fully green. Idempotency uses public_api_idempotency collection; keys stored in public_api_keys. Rate limit buckets are in-memory. Opera Cloud is MOCK — test-connection with missing creds returns 400 (verified). Frontend menu id for Platform Admin is 'super-admin' (not 'platform-admin' as review-request stated).
